notes.title: 25.06.15 DevLog
notes.content:
Developer Log
Hello again.
It’s been a while since the last post.
With some freelance work going on alongside development, updates have slowed down a bit—so I wanted to share what I’m currently working on.
Internal Refactoring & System Changes
The internal structure of the class responsible for applying damage and effects has been reworked.
Previously, only additive/subtractive effects stacked and resolved properly.

But in cases like:

“A 10-second attack power buff is applied, and then a 3-second buff is applied on top. When the 3-second buff ends, the game reverts to the default (no buff), ignoring the remaining duration of the 10-second buff.”

…you’d lose the longer buff entirely.
This has now been changed: all effects are stacked and unstacked in proper order, restoring previous values correctly.

It also now supports multiplicative effects, division, and overrides, restoring values properly when those effects expire.
Trait Management Updated Internally
The way ability traits are handled has been refactored for stability and flexibility.
Spirits(Weapon) Now Have Unique Skills
Each Spirits (weapon type) now has its own unique skill.
While only two Spirits currently exist, both now feature a special skill activated through a focus input.

White Tiger Spirit – White Tiger Fang:
Dash forward with a flurry of kicks. The final strike knocks enemies back.

Reaper’s Spirit – Soul Sever:
The player vanishes, slashes through enemies, and reappears while dashing again.
The player is invincible during the vanished state.
Ability Types Added
Each ability now has one or more types assigned to it.
(e.g. Magic, Nature, Fire / Physical, Blunt, Earth, etc.)
This allows for more nuanced trait interactions in future updates.
Ability Traits Expanded
Traits are now tied to specific abilities and sold by Un-Beak.

Some examples:

White Tiger Fang: Wrath, Endurance, Submission

Roar: Brutality, Pressure, Breath

Push: Force, Impact Transfer, Resolve

Unburning Flame: Lingering, Cleanse

Protected of Earth: Unyielding, Retaliation

Nature's Resilience: Meditation, Cycle, Growth

Flame Rage: Ignition, Overheat, Inflame

Crystallize:  Deflect, Overload

Full Moon: Chill Moon, Twin Moon, Moonlight

Guided Crystal: Homing, Multi-Shard

Impale: Radial Burst, Seeker

Other abilities are still in progress.
Icons for trait shards now show the related ability for easier identification.
Since the number of traits has increased, the UI for buying them will be overhauled—likely in the next or following update—to match the Reward Exchange UI style.
Additional Traits Planned
More traits will be added in upcoming patches.
Ability Logic Changes & Fixes
Some ability logic has been rewritten and several bugs have been fixed.


Team Member Recruitment
I'm currently looking for people who are interested in joining the project as fellow team members.
This is not a paid position—the game isn’t generating revenue at the moment—
but if you’re passionate about indie game development and want to build something together, you’re more than welcome!

Looking for:

Character concept artist
To draw character key art based on reference sheets, for use by 3D modelers.

If you're interested, feel free to contact me!

notes.title: 25.05.29 Update
notes.content:
The demo is scheduled to be updated sometime next week.

Important Notice

 Due to the difficulty of maintaining save file compatibility across major system changes,
 the save management system has been migrated to a version-based structure.
 Old save files may still function, but conflicts with the previous migration system can lead to loss of certain character data.
 I recommend starting a new game.


As a result of this change:
The Recovery Potion migration feature and The save point conversion system have been removed.



Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where XP values and equipped gear were overwritten with default values during loading after recent internal code changes.
 Fixed a bug where villagers spawned by the Soulbinder could respawn after resting.
 Fixed an issue where the dragon encounter event was not resetting properly.
 Fixed an issue where frame rate settings were not saved properly.
 Fixed a bug where the Texture Streaming Pool size setting was not saved correctly.
 Fixed an issue where the Harvester would remain in the world after the player died to it.


System Changes
Ability System Refactor

 Previous: A single instance of each ability was reused.

 This made abilities with input buffering or chaining extremely difficult to manage

 Now: Specific abilities will create a new instance each time they are used.


To support this change:

 Fixed threading issues caused by input competition during ability chaining.
 Input effects on the player are now more strictly enforced.

 e.g., SP regeneration only begins after an ability fully completes.

 To balance this: Some SP costs have been slightly reduced.


Combat Changes

 Players can now chain between light and heavy attacks freely.
 Previously: Light Dash → only Light Attack
 Now: Light Dash → Light or Heavy Attack



 Removed restrictions that prevented chaining near the end of light/heavy attack animations.
 Extended the input window for chaining.
 As a result, dodge chaining now triggers on button release instead of press.
 If an input is received during the valid chaining window, it now triggers immediately, without waiting for the window to end.

 Previously, only dodge chaining triggered immediately.

 Because chaining is now more responsive and combat speed has increased, damage values have been adjusted for balance.
 You can now change direction during specific frames of light/heavy attacks.
 It is now possible to unequip your current Spirit (weapon).




Progression

 Level-up XP table has been adjusted.
 XP rewards for certain monsters have been updated.



Miscellaneous Changes

 Cleaned up internal tag usage logic.
 AI no longer detects the player during executions.
 Some abilities used by the Goblin Battle Mage now track the player more accurately.
 Reduced the frequency of grotesque hair stretching bugs on villagers (groom asset issue).
 The Soulbinder is now invincible for 5 seconds after spawning.
 Added new attack patterns to The Harvester.
 Dragon breath damage has been reduced.
 Items can no longer be used while in a death state.


New Ability: Return of the Wraith

 Fires a slow-moving skull at a target.
 On hit, it deals damage and returns to the player.
 When it touches the player, it restores health.


New Item
Mark of the Wraith

 On hit, leaves a mark with a chance to deal damage based on the target’s max HP over a set duration.
 Against bosses, the effect is reduced to one-third.
 Enemies killed by this damage drop an additional 20% souls.


Spirit of Reaper

 Obtainable in the final portion of current playable content.
 Uses a unique Reaper-style animation set with wide scythe swings.
 Deals 50% physical / 50% magical damage.
 Has a wide attack range, but long end-lag after attacks.

Known Issues

 The state of the gate to the reservoir area is not saved correctly.
 The key remains in your inventory, so you can reopen the gate manually.
 This will be addressed in the next update.



Since I also need to cover living expenses, future updates may take longer than usual.

New Features
FSR 3 Upscaling Support

 AMD's FidelityFX Super Resolution 3 technology has been integrated.
 It enables high-quality visuals even at lower internal resolutions,
 offering a balance between enhanced performance and sharp image quality.
 Available when your system meets the minimum requirements.


FSR Frame Generation Added

 On supported high-performance GPUs, interpolated frames can now be inserted between rendered frames,
 increasing perceived frame rates (FPS) and delivering smoother gameplay.


Anti-Aliasing Mode Selection

 You can now select your preferred Anti-Aliasing method in the graphics settings.
 Note: Some options may be unavailable when using FSR upscaling or frame generation.


Important: Even if your hardware meets or exceeds recommended specifications,
the latest GPU drivers may be required to enable these features.


 Preset settings are no longer based on engine defaults — they now use developer-defined values.


Bug Fixes

notes.title: 25.03.05 Demo Version Update and Development Progress(데모 업데이트와 개발 상황에 대해)
notes.content:
Demo Update
• The demo version has been updated to match the content of the Early Access version.


About Demo
It seems the demo was released too early. Internally, things are still changing frequently, making it difficult to manage the demo.

I currently considering one of the following three options:
• Not releasing the demo until it reaches a certain stage.
• Leaving it as is and not updating it further.
• Updating only when there are major changes.



Past
There were side effects caused by using new technologies. 

These issues emerged from using World Partition and VT-related features for the first time. 

Recently, i believe i have resolved most of the errors related to DX12 and have consequently discontinued DX11 support.

Current
There are five major areas planned:
• Basement
• Twisted Forest
• Desert
• Snowfield
• Joseon Dynasty

The Basement and Forest are complete, and with this update, the Desert is about 50% finished.

Planned NPCs
• Merchant
• Fragment Management
• Reward Exchange

Except for the Merchant, NPCs currently have no dedicated models, so placeholder models are used. 

Humanoid NPCs, which are used for quests and environmental narration, have been implemented using MetaHumans.

NPCs to be Added
• Basic Skill Sales NPC: This NPC will sell skills that can be used at the beginning, and functionality will be provided using temporary modeling resources.

Planned Characters
• White Tiger
• Wolf
• Fox

Among these, only the White Tiger is playable. 

The White Tiger is designed as a melee-focused character, intended to dodge and follow up with additional attacks. 

If all goes well, the Wolf might be added as a playable character before summer. 

The Wolf is planned as a mid-range character that throws talismans to build stacks and uses magic attacks based on those stacks.



Future
While working on the Twisted Forest, I unexpectedly ended up handling the level design by myself. 

To save time, I reused pre-generated terrain, which resulted in an overly large level. 

I now believe that a residential area in the desert would be a more appropriate scale for future content.

The initial plan was to finish the Desert and then rework the Forest area, but it now seems better to start revising the Forest first. If possible, trolls and goblins will also be replaced.

---------------------------------

데모 버전 업데이트
• 데모 버전이 얼리 액세스 버전의 콘텐츠와 일치하도록 업데이트되었습니다.


데모에 관하여
데모 버전은 너무 빨리 출시된 것 같습니다. 아직 내부적으로 변경이 잦은 상태라, 데모를 관리하기가 어려운 상황입니다.

• 어느 정도 단계에 도달할 때까지 데모를 출시하지 않음.
• 현재 상태로 두고 더 이상 업데이트하지 않음.
• 대규모 변경이 있을 때만 업데이트.

이 세 가지 중 하나를 고민 중입니다.


과거
새 기술 사용으로 발생하는 부작용들이 많이 있었습니다. 

월드 파티션과 VT 관련 기능을 처음 사용하면서 생기는 문제들이며, 

최근에야 Dx12 관련 오류를 어느 정도 해결했다고 판단하고 DX11 지원을 종료했습니다.



현재
기획된 크게 다섯 가지 구역은 다음과 같습니다:

• 거점
• 뒤틀린 숲
• 사막
• 설원
• 조선

거점과 숲은 완료된 상태이며, 이번 업데이트로 사막의 50%까지 진행되었습니다.

기획된 NPC
• 상인
• 파편 관리
• 보상 교환

상인을 제외한 NPC는 모델링이 없어 대체 모델을 사용하고 있습니다. 

퀘스트 및 주변 상황 설명을 위한 인간형 NPC는 메타휴먼을 이용해 구현되었습니다.



추가해야 할 NPC
• 기본 기술 판매 NPC

초반에 사용할 수 있는 기술을 판매할 예정이며, 임시 모델링 리소스를 이용해 기능만 제공할 계획입니다.



기획된 캐릭터
• 백호
• 늑대
• 여우

셋 중 백호만 플레이 가능하며, 백호는 근접 평타 위주의 캐릭터로 기획되었습니다. 

피하고 후속타를 사용하길 기대하며 만들어졌습니다. 


일이 잘 풀리면 여름이 가기 전에 늑대가 플레이 가능한 캐릭터로 추가될 수 있습니다. 

늑대는 부적을 던져 스택을 쌓고, 이를 이용한 마법 공격을 사용하는 중근거리 캐릭터로 기획 중입니다.



미래
뒤틀린 숲을 작업할 당시 혼자서 레벨 디자인까지 하게 될 줄은 몰랐습니다. 

시간을 줄이기 위해 이미 생성된 지형을 가져와서 끼워 넣는 방식으로 작업하게 되었고, 결과적으로 너무 넓은 레벨이 되어버렸습니다. 

앞으로의 구성은 사막 거주 구역 정도가 적당하다고 생각합니다.



계획은 사막을 마무리하고 숲을 다시 작업할 생각이었으나, 

숲 구역을 먼저 손보는 것이 맞다고 판단됩니다. 

가능하면 트롤 및 고블린도 교체할 예정입니다.

Mitigated Frequent Crashes When Moving Between Locations Using Save Points
Previously, when transitioning between locations, layers were managed by unloading all unused layers. 

For example, when moving from the Twisted Forest to the Desert Canyon:
Unload the unused Twisted Forest layers -> Load the Desert Canyon layers -> Once the Desert Canyon layers have finished loading, move to the designated point.

While this worked fine in a DX11 environment, in DX12, errors often occurred in large areas when the layer load state was changed, causing frequent crashes.

To address this, the internal management system has been modified to keep all layers active and only change the state of very small, necessary areas.

 Certain actions that I didn't expect players to try.
 Parts that functioned correctly in the development tool but failed after packaging.
